title: TRICARE Premium-Based Plans Billing Schedule and Initial Payment
content:
**Premium billing operations - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans.**

## Clauses

1. Premiums are billed per coverage month at the tier's monthly premium for the premium rate year, and are due on the last calendar day of the month before the coverage month.
2. A purchase is accompanied by the tier's number of initial-payment months of premium, billed as initial-payment bills for the first coverage months, starting with the month that contains the coverage effective date.
3. When coverage starts after the first day of a month, that month's initial-payment bill covers only the days from the effective date to month end, at the monthly premium multiplied by those days and divided by the days in that month, rounded to the cent. The days in the month are the number of calendar days in the coverage month billed.
4. The plan is activated only after every initial-payment bill has a payment posted against it. This is read from the plan's premium ledger: each initial-payment bill of the plan must have a payment referencing it.
5. Bills are posted only on a plan whose status is applied or active.
6. Premiums never count toward any catastrophic cap.

## Bills on the premium ledger

A bill is one of four kinds - an initial-payment bill, a regular monthly premium, a partial-month premium, or a coverage-type adjustment - and covers one coverage month, for the days of that month it states. The plan's premium balance rises with bills and with refunds of credit balances, and falls with payments and credits; a negative balance is a credit owed to the purchaser.

## Clause 5 by plan status

| Plan status | A bill may be posted |
|---|---|
| applied | yes |
| active | yes |
| rejected | no |
| terminated by request, for nonpayment, or for ineligibility | no |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family purchase (monthly premium 301.82) with a coverage effective date of 12 September, and 2 initial-payment months:

| Initial-payment bill | Days covered | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| September | 12 to 30 September, 19 of 30 days | 301.82 multiplied by 19, divided by 30, is 191.1527, rounded to 191.15 |
| October | the whole month | 301.82 |

The plan becomes active only once both bills have a payment posted against them.
